license_required.quote: No person or firm shall issue a report on financial statements of, or provide attest services for, any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit unless the person or firm is licensed or registered under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Public Accountancy.

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate degree with 150 semester hours including 42 semester hours of accounting, auditing, and related subjects
degree_required.quote: 150 or more semester hours of college credit at a college or university recognized by the Board, including a baccalaureate degree and a minimum of 42 semester hours of accounting, auditing, and related subjects

accrediting_body.value: college or university recognized by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: college or university recognized by the Board

required.quote: one year of experience in public accounting, meeting the requirements prescribed by Board rule or other experience or employment that the Board in its discretion considers substantially equivalent

duration.quote: one year of experience in public accounting

kind.quote: one year of experience in public accounting, meeting the requirements prescribed by Board rule

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Nationally recognized uniform certified public accountants' examination and advisory grading service
exams.quote: The Board shall administer an examination using a nationally recognized uniform certified public accountants' examination and advisory grading service.

interval_years.quote: Public accountant licenses and firm registrations under this chapter shall be renewed every two years on payment of the required fee.

required.quote: As a condition of renewal of a license as a public accountant, the Board may require that the licensee establish that he or she has satisfied continuing education requirements established by Board rule.

hours_per_period.quote: adopt rules establishing reasonable continuing education requirements, not to exceed 40 hours per year
hours_per_period.citation: § 54. General powers and duties of the Board

period_years.quote: not to exceed 40 hours per year
period_years.citation: § 54. General powers and duties of the Board

available.quote: Without requiring an examination, the Board shall issue an appropriate license to a public accountant who is licensed or certified under the laws of another state

requirements.value: Licensed in another state with substantially equal education, examination, and experience requirements; or five years of experience in public accountancy within the last 10 years plus continuing education compliance.
requirements.quote: with education, examination, and experience requirements that the Board considers to be substantially equal to those of this State; or upon a showing that the applicant has had five years of experience in the practice of public accountancy or meets equivalent requirements prescribed by the Board by rule within the 10 years immediately preceding the application

regulatory_model.quote: No person or firm shall issue a report on financial statements of, or provide attest services for, any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit unless the person or firm is licensed or registered under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No individual person may use the title "certified public accountant," "CPA," "registered public accountant," "RPA," or "auditor" or any other title tending to indicate that he or she is a public accountant, unless he or she is licensed as a public accountant under this chapter or is an individual with practice privileges set forth under section 74c of this title.

scope_protection.quote: No person or firm shall hold themselves out as public accountants while engaged in the practice of public accounting unless they: (1) hold a valid license or registration issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state, country, or federal agency against a license or certificate to practice public accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action by another state or country or federal agency of a license or certificate to practice public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make available copies of documents prepared for and paid for by the client upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make available, upon request of a person using public accounting services, copies of documents in the possession or under the control of the accountant, when those documents have been prepared for and paid for by the user of services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to return client-supplied information and documents upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to return client-supplied information and documents, in whatever form contained, upon request of the client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting and performing public accounting responsibilities the licensee knows or has reason to know they are not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting and performing public accounting responsibilities that the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing public accounting services not authorized by the consumer or their legal representative
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing public accounting services that have not been authorized by the consumer or the consumer's legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence in the practice of public accountancy, including misleading or deceptive representations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence in the practice of public accountancy, including making misleading, deceptive, or untrue representations in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement in support of an application filed by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The making of any false or misleading statement in support of an application filed by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide explanation or documentation requested by the Board regarding evidence submitted in support of another's licensure application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to provide any explanation requested by the Board regarding evidence submitted by the licensee in support of an application for licensure filed by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report changes to the Board as required by statute and the Board's rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report changes to the Board as required by statute and the Board's rules.

citations.cite: § 54. General powers and duties of the Board

definition_quote.value: the performance or the offering to perform by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as being licensed, registered, or otherwise authorized under this chapter, for a client or potential client, of one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.
definition_quote.quote: the performance or the offering to perform by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as being licensed, registered, or otherwise authorized under this chapter, for a client or potential client, of one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: issuance of reports on financial statements
methods_authorized.quote: one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or of one or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
review or compilation of financial statements in accordance with SSARS
examination of prospective financial information in accordance with SSAE
engagement in accordance with PCAOB auditing standards
examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement in accordance with SSAE (other than prospective financial information examination)
attest_services_types.quote: any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); any review of a financial statement or compilation of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB); or any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presented in the form of financial statements or information that represents management or owners without expressing any type of assurance on the statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: 150 or more semester hours of college credit at a college or university recognized by the Board, including a baccalaureate degree

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: An applicant who has not yet completed a baccalaureate degree may sit for the exam upon the completion of 120 semester hours at an institution recognized by the Board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: an individual who performs professional services pursuant to this section shall not be assessed a fee or be required to provide notice to the Board.

value: personal and subject matter jurisdiction and the disciplinary authority of the Board
compliance with this chapter and the Board's administrative rules and any other laws governing the practice of the profession in this State

cease offering or rendering professional services in this State if the license issued by the state of the licensee's principal place of business is no longer valid or is otherwise conditioned or restricted
appointment of the state board or licensing authority as the agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the Board against the licensee
perform only those services within the scope of practice authorized by the state of the licensee's principal place of business
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: personal and subject matter jurisdiction and the disciplinary authority of the Board; compliance with this chapter and the Board's administrative rules and any other laws governing the practice of the profession in this State under the jurisdiction of the Board; cease offering or rendering professional services in this State individually and on behalf of a firm in the event the license issued by the state of the licensee's principal place of business is no longer valid or is otherwise conditioned or restricted; the appointment of the state board or licensing authority, which issued its license, as the agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the Board against the licensee; and perform only those services within the scope of practice authorized by the state of the licensee's principal place of business.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual practicing pursuant to this section and who performs services in this State, or an individual practicing pursuant to this section and who performs services for an entity with its home office in this State, may only provide the following services through a firm registered under section 74 of this title

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of equity, creditor and voting rights of all partners, officers, members, shareholders, or managers, belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any CPA or RPA firm as defined in this chapter may include nonlicensee owners

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The Board may by rule require, on either a uniform or a random basis, as a condition to renewal of firm registrations under section 74 of this title, that applicants undergo peer reviews

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: peer reviews conducted no more frequently than once every three years

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Information submitted for peer reviews is exempt from public disclosure under 1 V.S.A. § 317(c)(3) and (6).

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may perform those services set forth in subdivision 13(1)(A)(ii), 13(1)(A)(v), or 13(3) of this chapter for a client with a home office in this State, may otherwise practice public accounting as authorized under this chapter, and may use the title "CPA" or "CPA firm" without a registration issued only if the firm

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each office in this State shall be under the supervision of a public accountant who is licensed in this State.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee who is responsible for supervising attest services and signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountant's report on behalf of the firm shall meet the experience and competency requirements set out in the professional standards for such services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: No firm or any of its employees or other public accountants engaged by the firm, shall disclose any confidential information obtained in the course of a professional engagement except with the consent of the client or former client or as disclosure may be required by law, legal process, or the standards of the profession.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a public accountant incident to or in the course of professional services to clients, except reports submitted by a public accountant to a client, are the property of the accountant.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm shall be required to obtain registration pursuant to this section if the firm: (1) has an office established or maintained in this State for the practice of public accounting

client_records_return_obligation.quote: Failing to return client-supplied information and documents, in whatever form contained, upon request of the client
